releases.notes:
## **Mitra's Auto Sprinter v1.9.0 - "The Polish Round"**
**Release Date:** 2026-10-11

A quality-of-life release: one long-standing bug finally put down, a real command, a smarter HUD editor, and a config screen that got simpler instead of bigger. It also ships alongside the first Minecraft 26.3 build.

### ⚠️ Before You Upgrade
* **Versions:** Minecraft 26.2 needs the `fabric-mc26.2` jar, Minecraft 26.3 needs the `fabric-mc26.3` jar. Both need Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.x, Fzzy Config 0.7.7+26.x, and Java 25+.
* **One-time label reset:** the Blocked Reasons tab moved into the Labels section, so customized blocked-reason labels reset to their defaults once after upgrading. Everything else (position, colors, toggles, scales) carries over automatically.
* **Renamed config layout:** the config is now three tabs (Sprint, HUD, Labels) instead of four, and the HUD groups are Visibility & Mode, Position & Size, Colors & Shadow, and Background. Grouping is cosmetic; nothing was deleted.
* **New defaults:** Rounded Corners is on by default (the corner radius follows the background padding), and Background Padding now goes up to 20 instead of the old fixed 3. Both default to looking the same as 1.8.0 until you touch them.

### 🎵 What's New
* **`/mitrasautosprinter` command:** type it in chat and the config screen opens.
* **HUD editor state preview:** press **N** in the HUD editor to cycle through every state the HUD can show (ON, OFF, each blocked reason, unknown, and the loading labels), so you can position and size it against the longest label instead of guessing.
* **Rounded corners:** the background box can now have rounded corners, on by default. Crank the Background Padding slider for a chunkier rounded panel look, or turn the toggle off for the classic sharp box.
* **Separate Unknown color:** the "Unknown Reason" label gets its own color setting instead of borrowing the blocked color, so a Minecraft update adding an unmodeled sprint restriction is visually distinct from "you are too hungry".

### 🛠️ Fixes & Tweaks
* **Vanilla Toggle Sprint compatibility:** if you use Minecraft's own Toggle Sprint option, the mod could show "Unknown Reason" and quietly stop sprinting you, depending on the order you enabled things. The mod now speaks toggle sprint's language: it latches once instead of flipping the key every tick, and turning the mod off restores your toggle state instead of fighting it.
* **Readable positions:** dragging the HUD no longer writes values like 0.56558995 into the config; they are rounded to four decimals (0.5656), which is sub-pixel accurate.
* **Editor instructions:** the on-screen editor help is now one instruction per line instead of a dash-joined run-on sentence.

### 📚 Docs
* **README.md:** slimmed down to what the mod is, supported versions, links, and license.
* **GUIDE.md:** new, holds everything detailed that left the README: setup, the full HUD state reference, editor controls, and the settings rundown.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mitra-88/Mitras-Auto-Sprinter/compare/1.8.0-mc26.2...1.9.0-mc26.2

releases.notes:
## [1.8.0] - 2026-09-17

> [!TIP]
> This update adds new settings but your existing config file keeps working. If anything looks off after updating, just delete your old config file (`config/mitrasautosprinter/mitrasautosprinter.toml`) and the mod will make a new one.

## ✨ What's New
- **"Unknown Reason" Fallback**: If something blocks your sprint that the mod doesn't recognize (for example, a brand-new Minecraft update adding a new restriction), the HUD now shows a configurable **Unknown Reason** label in the blocked color instead of incorrectly claiming "Sprint ON". Find it under *Labels → Unknown Reason Label*.
- **Emoji-Safe Rainbow & Chroma**: The per-letter color animation now works on whole characters, so emoji and other multi-byte symbols render correctly in Rainbow/Chroma mode instead of splitting into broken halves.

## 🐛 Fixes & Stability
- The **Blocked Format** label setting (`Sprint OFF - %s`) is now actually applied. It previously existed but was ignored, so blocked reasons showed as bare text like "Too Hungry" instead of "Sprint OFF - Too Hungry". `%s` marks where the reason goes.
- HUD **text, color, and icon brightness now update together as one unit**, fixing rare frames where the label said one thing while the color or icon brightness said another.
- The **custom anchor** position now defaults to the center of the screen (0.5, 0.5) instead of near the top-left corner.

## ⚡ Performance
- The HUD's render path is now **allocation-free**: letters are laid out once per label change, colors come from a precomputed lookup table, and label width is measured at most once per second instead of every frame. Less per-frame garbage and no text jitter when labels change.

## 📦 Dependencies
- **Fzzy Config** 0.7.7+26.2 is now the required minimum, so make sure you update it alongside the mod.
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) ≥20.0.2 suggested.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mitra-88/Mitras-Auto-Sprinter/compare/1.7.0-mc26.2...1.8.0-mc26.2

## [1.7.0] - 2026-09-09

> [!TIP]
> If anything looks off after updating, just delete your old config file (`config/mitrasautosprinter/mitrasautosprinter.toml`) the mod will make a new one, and you can set your settings again in no time.

## ✨ What's New
- **Rainbow & Chroma Text Colors**: The text HUD label can now animate its colors! **Rainbow** smoothly cycles the whole label through the color spectrum, while **Chroma** gives each letter its own shifting hue for a wave effect. Find it under *HUD → Text Color Mode* (text display mode only).
- **Scalable Text**: A new **Text Scale** setting (0.25–8) lets you resize the text label just like the icon Solid, Rainbow, and Chroma all scale, and positioning/clamping respects the new size automatically.
- **Snap-to-Place HUD Editor**: Dragging the HUD now snaps to screen edges, center lines, the default top position, and the bottom-safe area, with magenta **guide lines** as feedback and a live **x/y readout** while dragging. Also in the editor:
  - **Mouse wheel** or **`+` / `-` keys** resize the HUD in whichever display mode is active.
  - **G** toggles an 8-pixel alignment grid (with brighter lines every 32px).
  - **Arrow keys** nudge by 1px hold **Shift** for bigger steps.
  - **Double-click** centers the HUD horizontally, and holding **Ctrl** disables snapping while dragging.
- **Smarter Sprint Reasons**: The HUD now mirrors the game's *actual* sprint rules including while **swimming** so the reason shown is accurate in far more situations. The old *Dead*, *Spectating*, and *Riding* reasons were removed, and *Blindness* is now reported as the more general **Restricted**.
- **Resolution-Independent Positioning**: Custom HUD positions are saved as screen-relative coordinates, so your layout survives resolution changes, GUI scale changes, and different window sizes.
- **Reorganized Settings Screen**: The HUD section is now grouped into three collapsible categories (*Visibility & Mode*, *Position & Size*, *Style & Colors*), with plain-language descriptions on every setting and color options finally show their proper names instead of raw internal keys.

## 🐛 Fixes & Stability
- If the sprint HUD ever fails to draw, it no longer stays dead for your entire session. It now **recovers automatically when you change worlds** or instantly when you open the HUD editor, and the chat message tells you how to fix it.
- Fixed the solid text label being drawn **twice per frame**.
- The **background box** setting is now clearly marked as Text-mode-only, since it isn't drawn behind icons.

## ⚡ Performance
- Configurable HUD colors are now cached and only refreshed when you change them in the settings, instead of being rebuilt every tick and every frame.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mitra-88/Mitras-Auto-Sprinter/compare/1.6.0-mc26.2...1.7.0-mc26.2

## [1.6.0] - What's New for Players

> [!NOTE]
> **Important Requirements & Breaking Change**:
> - This update replaces the old text config file with a native settings menu inside Minecraft! Your old `mitrasautosprinter.properties` file is no longer used.
> - **Required Mods**: You must now install [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config) and [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) alongside this mod to edit your settings in-game.

## ✨ What's New
- **New Icon Display Mode**: You can now swap the text indicator for a clean Speed Effect Icon! It renders at full brightness while sprinting and fades to 35% opacity when stopped, automatically matching your active resource pack.
- **In-Editor Icon Resizing**: Scale the icon size on the fly directly inside the HUD editor using your **mouse wheel** or the **`+` / `-` keys** (numpad supported).
- **In-Game Settings Menu**: Full Mod Menu support! Tweak every option through a native UI without touching configuration files manually.
- **HUD Anchor Presets & Customization**: Snap the HUD to preset screen positions, toggle text shadows, and set custom visibility rules.

## ⚡ Performance & Stability
- Reduced memory overhead by eliminating per-tick garbage collection during sprint state checks.
- Overhauled HUD bounds tracking so editor dragging and screen clamping automatically match icon or text dimensions seamlessly.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mitra-88/Mitras-Auto-Sprinter/compare/1.5.0-mc26.2...1.6.0-mc26.2
